A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Mandalorian''' died from suffocation due to an [[Allergy/Legends|allergic]] reaction to [[Blisterbug]] [[Poison/Legends|venom]]. Although his chest started to swell, he refused to remove the [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|breastplate]] as he believed it would insult his honor. [[Ro-San Borokki]] witnessed his [[Death/Legends|death]], and noted in her chapter "The Hunt" in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] died from "''stubbornness''".<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mandalorian was briefly mentioned in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' which was released on [[October 15]], [[2013]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]] and [[Jason Fry]].
